name: Photo Editor
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Photo Editor changes a photo in the way you describe. Choose a photo from your MegaScenes library and say what you want: replace the background with a beach at sunset, remove a person or an object, change the colors or the clothes, improve the lighting, or turn the photo into a watercolor painting. You can also add elements taken from up to three other images.

ChatGPT shows your recent photos, tells you what the edit needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The edited photo appears in the chat and is saved in your library next to the original.

Useful for product photos, social media posts, online listings, profile pictures and quick fixes.

Limitations: it edits images already in your MegaScenes library; pictures attached in the chat are not passed to the plugin. The result is a new image, the original stays as it was. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
